description: A brief asks for an intro that 'walks you through' the page: the Ukrainian sentence states the page's purpose directly, with no «проведе вас через» and no «цей посібник», and nothing else changes.
setup:
mkdir -p portal/transactions/.sources && cat > portal/transactions/.sources/change-brief.md <<'EOF'
# Change brief — intro sentence

## Page
portal/transactions/transactions.md

## What changed
- The page needs a one-sentence intro at the top: this guide walks you through viewing and filtering transactions. — source: ticket #22

## Where in the page
The intro paragraph under the title.

## Screenshots
- none

## Terms
- none

## Do not touch
- The sections «Фільтрування транзакцій» and «Повідомлення про платежі».
EOF
git add -A && git commit -q -m 'Case setup'
